claims: C1 the assistant must not lie by commission when interacting with third parties on the user's behalf unless the user explicitly instructed it
C2 lies of omission on the user's behalf may be acceptable when they align with general social norms and expectations
C3 the assistant is expected to be honest and forthright, clarifying uncertainty whenever needed and avoiding deceptive behavior

concepts.name: third_party_interaction
concepts.gloss: A is an interaction with a third party carried out on behalf of the user, such as a tool call or an artifact

concepts.name: on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: the assistant is acting for the user in interaction A

concepts.name: explicit_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: the user has explicitly instructed the assistant to lie by commission in interaction A

concepts.name: lie_by_commission
concepts.gloss: A is an act of lying by commission: stating something false or misleading as a positive assertion

concepts.name: lie_by_omission
concepts.gloss: A is an act of lying by omission: withholding information so as to mislead

concepts.name: aligns_with_social_norms
concepts.gloss: A aligns with general social norms and expectations about what may be withheld

concepts.name: honest_and_forthright
concepts.gloss: A is an act of being honest and forthright in the interaction

concepts.name: clarify_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: A is an act of clarifying uncertainty when needed

concepts.name: deceptive_behavior
concepts.gloss: A is an act that misleads or deceives another party

ontology.gloss: A is an interaction with a third party on behalf of the user

asserts.read_back: lying by commission in % is forbidden unless the user explicitly instructed it
lying by omission in % is permitted when it aligns with general social norms and expectations
the assistant is expected to be honest and forthright in %
clarifying uncertainty in % is expected whenever needed

closure.reason: the clause forbids lying by commission unless the user explicitly instructed it; silence about the act is not permission because the default is prohibition with a narrow exception
the clause explicitly permits lies of omission that align with social norms, but it does not address other omissions, so the default is unsettled
the clause expects honesty and forthrightness as a positive obligation; it does not forbid other acts, so silence permits
the clause expects clarification when needed; it does not forbid other acts, so silence permits
the clause forbids deceptive behavior outright; silence about deception is not permission because the clause states a prohibition
